# DHI Manchester

> A sports psychology and mental resilience resource for athletes seeking evidence-based strategies for performance anxiety, stress management, and confidence building.

DHI Manchester provides expert guidance on athlete mental health and psychological resilience. The site features content from sports psychology specialist Mia Strah, focusing on practical techniques for managing performance anxiety and building mental toughness in competitive athletes.

- performance-anxiety

## Mental Resilience & Performance

- [Performance Anxiety in Athletes: Strategies for Resilience & Confidence](https://dhimanchester.co.uk/performance-anxiety-in-athletes-strategies-for-mental-resilience-focus-and-confidence): Performance anxiety strategies for athletes by Mia Strah at DHI Manchester
- [Self-Discipline Books for Athletes: Mastering Resilience & Stress](https://dhimanchester.co.uk/self-discipline-books-for-athletes-mastering-mental-resilience-and-stress-management-techniques): Self-discipline and stress management guide for athletes by Mia Strah
